degree_rationale: What virgin and continent (encratite) truly are — six layered meanings each, from the untasted Light, to the chosen out of mingling, to the Mind of Light, the New Man, the celibate man, the man who leaves wife. Plus the dragon's seven-fold of head (sense organs) and seven-fold of body. Treats the natural-bodily distinction of holy states.
direction_rationale: Inward reception/discrimination of what 'virgin' and 'continent' mean across cosmic and bodily layers. Reflective unfolding.
grand_man_function: Natural sanctity-discrimination — the inward unpacking of holy states.
title: What the Virgin truly is and what the Continent (Encratite) is
